summary: So much thinking happens in space between notes Timing lost on thought so search for harmony which dwells within silence as tones bounce on tenacity of borrowed wind. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
So much thinking happens in
space between notes
Timing lost on thought
so search for harmony which
dwells within
silence as tones bounce on
tenacity of borrowed wind.
#smallpoems
